launches.title: Sotel: Network-Intelligent eSIM for global connectivity
launches.tagline: We connect travellers and remote teams to the best mobile networks in real-time
launches.body:
Hi Everyone! I’m Emmanuel, co-founder of [Termii](https://termii.com) (YC W20), and we’re launching [Sotel](https://sotel.com), a network-intelligent eSIM app that gives you seamless mobile connectivity in 180+ countries — no SIM cards, no hidden fees.

📌 **TL;DR**\
[Sotel](https://sotel.com) is the easiest way to get mobile data globally. We intelligently and automatically analyze carrier coverage, switching you to the best local network in real-time based on your location, usage pattern, and performance needs.

**The Problem:**\
Millions of people — especially remote teams, travellers, and startup nomads — suffer from:

* Expensive roaming charges
* Poor network performance when travelling
* Fragmented eSIM platforms with no real-time optimization
* No visibility into where their connection is weakest (until it fails)

**Our Solution:**\
🔁 **Dynamic Network Optimization**: We evaluate local carriers in real-time and connect you to the one with the best speed, latency, and coverage — using network and signal intelligence.\
📱 **Global eSIM Access**: Download once, connect anywhere. We offer affordable plans across 180+ countries.\
📊 **Smart Usage Dashboard**: Track data usage, get alerts and optimize performance before a video call drops.\
🛡️ **Privacy-Focused**: No personal ID is needed for 95% of destinations.

**Why We’re Building This**\
At Termii, we power critical communication APIs used by 20,000+ businesses processing 2B+ transactions annually. As we expanded globally, we ran into the same issue our users faced — unpredictable and expensive connectivity. Sotel is our solution, built from the ground up for modern, mobile-first users.

**Who It’s For**

* International teams and remote workers
* Frequent travellers, digital nomads
* Businesses that want to keep their global staff always connected
* Developers integrating global IoT/M2M connectivity

**Traction So Far:**

* Pilots running across 4 continents
* Partnered with major telecom companies in Africa, US & Europe

**Try it now**: [Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sotel.mobile&pcampaignid=web_share) and [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ng/app/sotel/id6740035152)

**We're Looking For:**

* Feedback from global users, remote workers, and telco nerds
* Partnerships with travel, fintech, and remote work platforms
* Early adopters to test our Intelligent switching engine
* Investors interested in telco infrastructure + AI

Let’s chat → [founders@termii.com](https://mailto:founders@termii.com)

launches.tagline: We help businesses 5x their engagement with interactive & conversational texts over RCS.
launches.body:
Hey everyone, I’m [Kunal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kunal-puri1/) - founder of Smobi 👋

# **📖 TLDR**

Smobi is the AI-powered platform for branded, interactive business messaging, starting with RCS. We **help businesses send rich, personalized texts** that build trust, drive engagement, and create real conversations.

If SMS messaging is part of your strategy, we’d love to show you how you can do more!

Book a Demo: https://www.smobi.com/contact

# **🎬 Our Launch Video:**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oJkl6m7RxgI

# **‼️ Why This Matters**

Modern customer engagement is broken. Despite the abundance of messaging channels - email, SMS, WhatsApp, in-app notifications, and voice - most brand communications feel impersonal, transactional, and spammy. **Consumers are overwhelmed with noise**:

* 82% of consumers received a spam text in the past week
* 70% of consumers will penalize a business for a poor communication experience
* 35% of consumers are annoyed by impersonalized and irrelevant content

Messages go unread. Calls go unanswered. Engagement is at an all time low. The problem is clear, all of us have felt it.

# **🛠 Our Solution**

RCS addresses these issues with verified, branded, and interactive messages and it is finally here in the US. However most businesses don’t know it exists, and the few that do are still figuring out how to use it.

**Smobi changes that**. We know exactly how to unlock RCS to drive real value.

With Smobi, you can:

* 👷 Create complex AI-powered conversational flows in minutes
* 🚀 Launch them via API or campaign
* 📊 Analyze every tap, interaction, and read

We also handle the strict carrier vetting and compliance, so you don’t have to.

**The results speak for themselves**:

* ⚡ On average, 5 - 10x the engagement vs SMS
* 🎯 4x higher CTR than SMS
* 💳 Up to 3x increase in purchase intent

# **🙏 Join Us**

We’re already helping innovative businesses in industries such as healthcare, entertainment, and fintech, leverage RCS to provide the most unique experiences for their customers. 

If you’re interested in doing the same, let’s talk.

\
Book a Demo: https://www.smobi.com/contact

launches.title: Smobi - New age marketplace for businesses for sale
launches.tagline: Bringing main-street business acquisitions to the 21st century
launches.body:
# Overview

Hi everyone, we’re [Kunal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kunal-puri1/) and [Michael](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mning1598/) from [Smobi](https://smobimarket.com/)!

Smobi is a marketplace that makes it **easy for buyers** to purchase brick & mortar small businesses. We do this by **verifying business listing data** and **managing deal-flow** on our platform.

Website: [smobimarket.com](http://smobimarket.com)

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fc69c6f56-e67a-45b9-904d-ee8c7ea7f4f0_3456x1812.png)

### **The Problem:**

* Buyers have to go through numerous listings to find quality businesses because most listings are **incomplete and misrepresented**
* Business brokers and owners who are looking to sell, **waste their time** working with buyers who aren’t qualified to purchase their business
* In the past 30 years, technology has only changed the business for sale market in **two** ways:
  * Listings have moved online instead of being in the local newspaper
  * Financial documents are emailed instead of being sent via mail
* The baby boomer generation is retiring over the next decade, who owns **1\.4 million businesses** that will close their doors unless they are sold to someone willing to buy them

### **The Solution:**

For those looking to buy, we utilize first and third party data to screen listings, so buyers are looking at the complete picture of the business that is for sale. Buyers can keep track of the state of each of the listings they are interested in and manage deal flow on the platform.

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4c68aba5-bbb6-4d50-9daf-4afef20fb191_3456x1822.png)

Additionally, we create NDA protected data rooms with more in-depth documents for each listing on our website. If the broker / seller of the business thinks you’re a good match for buying the business, we send the data room to the buyer.

For those looking to sell their business, we create a comprehensive profile for each buyer that is interested in a listing that the seller has created. Using data that the buyer has provided and our internal business logic, we classify how well of a match a person is for your business, ultimately saving time in your search for a buyer.

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F465d0d7a-7313-4cb9-a80a-e6011294ea8c_3454x1828.png)

### **Our Vision:**

Our long term vision is to **digitize the entire acquisition process** for main-street businesses, ultimately making small business ownership attainable for everyone.

### **Who Are We?**

Hi everyone, we are Kunal and Michael, and we are building Smobi. Our mission is to make small business ownership attainable by everyone.

Kunal formerly worked in Amazon Advertising, where he built several notification delivery channels that supported 10B+ communications annually. Kunal spent over 6 months in 2022 looking to purchase multiple SMBs and found the process of finding and purchasing a business to be extremely complex, especially for a first time buyer.

Before Smobi, Michael worked at another YC startup, Dover, as an early engineer where he worked on growth initiatives and building AI products.

Kunal and Michael grew up together, have known each other for 10 years, and now both reside in NYC. Together, we are attempting to simplify the small business acquisition process for all parties involved.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73135&key=user_uploads/846621/2ed626b9-972e-4a72-84c0-fe19ecf48dee)

### **Our Asks**

Thank you for reading about Smobi! We welcome any feedback for our platform as we are just beginning!

* **Sign up today**: Sign up and browse 700+ businesses for sale and get notified when businesses come up for sale tailored to your preferences.
* **Join our newsletter**: Sign up for our [blog](https://smobi.com/blog) for guides on how to buy and sell SMBs!
* **Give us your feedback**: Tell us more about what criteria and information you would want before purchasing a SMB
* **Connect us**: Help us connect with SBA approved lenders, business brokers, people looking to purchase small businesses, and owners looking to sell their business

launches.title: Apten: omni-channel AI agents for B2C sales/marketing
launches.tagline: Convert more leads across text, call, email, and webchat.
launches.body:
TLDR: Apten is an **omni-channel AI agent** that engages and nurtures leads across **text, call, and email, and webchat.**

Webchat specifically has been around for ages - but when a lead starts a conversation on the website and leaves halfway through, **they’re** **gone.**

Apten is not only able to start a conversation through webchat, but **proactively reach out via SMS/voice/email once the lead goes inactive.**

Today, Apten automates sales/marketing for hundreds of thousands of leads each month - we work with some of the largest enterprises in consumer services (industries including home services, healthcare, education, financial services, and insurance).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=63At2HXNX4k

# **The Problem**

B2C services companies today **(insurance, home services, financial services, education, etc)** rely on a combination of call centers, dialers, email/sms marketing automation systems to convert new leads.

These systems fall short because:

* Human teams are required to scale up dialing/call efforts (leads slip through the cracks)
* SMS/email automations are typically one-way, static sequences without personalization

# **Our Solution**

Apten automates sales and marketing for B2C enterprises with:

* **Omni-channel capabilities**: set up a single conversational flow that works across SMS, voice, email, and webchat.
  * Apten maintains unified memory across SMS, voice, emai, and webchat (just like a human does) to **personalize conversations at scale**
  * Apten can also **switch between channels** at anytime to **meet a lead where they want to be met**
  * Move leads through different conversational flows depending on **where they are in the customer/lead journey**
* **Intelligent follow-up:** Apten will not only personalize follow-ups based on what it knows about a lead or a past conversation, but it will also dynamically adjust **when to follow-up based on a lead’s repsonse**
  * Personalized AI voicemails can be left on dial attempts that go to an answering machine
  * Apten is able to use local presence dialing to auto-match the number it dials from to one that best matches the lead’s area code
* **AI tools:** Apten can take actions with your systems (scheduling, dialers, quote APIs, etc)
* **Human in the loop:** Handles transfers to your human team at any time (cold or warm). Apten can also dynamically transfer to specific numbers depending on
* **Reliability:** setup custom guardrails that automatically detect non-compliant messages and proactively fix them before they’re sent to the lead

# **Our Ask**

If you’re an enterprise that:

* Falls in a consumer services industry (home services, financial services, insurance, education, healthcare, auto, law, etc)
* Generates a high volume of leads (5k+ leads / mo)
* Uses marketing automation (drip texts/emails, dialer sequences) + a sales team/call center to engage leads over the phone

We’d love to chat - you can find us at http://apten.ai.

**TLDR:** We help B2C businesses automate sales, marketing, and customer service through SMS text. Customize Apten, and it’ll **proactively reach out, respond at any time, and never forget to follow up.**

Hey everyone - we’re [Daniel](https://linkedin.com/in/danielho799) & [Roshan](https://linkedin.com/in/roshan-kumaraswamy), the founders of [Apten](https://www.apten.ai/)! 👋 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81132&key=user_uploads/1547400/595aa8ba-e1da-4e01-b095-a4182f7b1836)

# **The Problem**

Businesses currently rely on humans or traditional SMS automation (drip texting) to qualify and nurture leads. This applies to both inbound leads (e.g., ad -> website -> fills out contact/quote form and leaves phone number) and the re-engagement of existing leads in a CRM. 

Example industries where this happens: real estate, insurance, home services

# **The Solution**

An AI SMS assistant that qualifies and nurtures leads in a **personable way** while responding 24/7 and automatically following up. 

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iuMYEZ4jYHE**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iuMYEZ4jYHE)

Customize:

* Apten’s knowledge (FAQs, info about your business, specific instructions/rules)
* Specific conversation flows and follow-up schedules for **different types of leads**

Apten won’t just chat - it’ll **take actions** in a way a human would to help your business by proactively:

* Categorizing/tagging leads based on the conversation
* Creating notifications based on conditions you define
* Determining the appropriate time to follow-up based on a lead's response

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81132&key=user_uploads/1547400/6db38255-433a-4ddb-9826-20ffd76ebd45)

We’ll provide white-glove onboarding and support the whole way!

launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re [Sean](https://www.linkedin.com/in/seanroades/) and [Ivan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aivanzhang/) from [Pinnacle](https://www.trypinnacle.app/). \
\
Today, we’re launching [our API](https://docs.trypinnacle.app/api-reference/endpoint/introduction) to send and receive RCS (Next-Gen SMS) text messages natively on user’s devices. We’re also launching an [SDK for Python](https://docs.trypinnacle.app/documentation/python/quick-start) (\`pip install rcs\`). If you’re currently sending SMS, you should probably be using Pinnacle.\
\
Here’s a quick example of how we used our API to sell our [Founder Mode hats](https://shop.trypinnacle.app/products/founder-mode-holy-edition-hat?) (certified by Brian himself 😉)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84168&key=user_uploads/1439340/3c12589b-527f-4fcc-bc9b-f6ecaf5b555e)

# The problem

Short: SMS sucks. \
Long: SMS messages have high friction from sending a message to checking out a customer. Interactivity is very limiting with SMS.

# The solution

Short: RCS rocks.\
Long: RCS messages reduce high friction for customers to buy products with a single tap and add interactivity through buttons, card carousels, and actions.

# Why now
This hasn't been possible until now. Apple rolled out RCS this week on iOS 18. Carrier adoption has been fully supported on all Android devices just this year. Carrier adoption for iOS completes in a couple months. We segment by device so you can adopt RCS incrementally.

# Our asks

* Share - tell your friends & colleagues about Pinnacle
* YC Companies - **reach out to us (**[**founders@trypinnacle.app**](mailto:founders@trypinnacle.app)**) to join our private beta**. You'll also get a **free Founder Mode hat**, designed by us, **1000 messages / mo free**, and our **24/7 #FounderMode support**.
